1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi.Uwiteka, warandondoye uramenya,

2.text: Uzi imyicarire yanjye n'imihagurukire yanjye,Umenyera kure ibyo nibwira.

3.text: Ujya urondora imigendere yanjye n'imiryamire,Uzi inzira zanjye zose.

4.text: Kuko ijambo ritaraba mu rurimi rwanjye,Uba umaze kurimenya rwose, Uwiteka.

6.text: Kumenya ibikomeye bityo ni igitangaza kinanira,Kuransumba simbasha kukugeraho.

7.text: Ndahungira Umwuka wawe he?Ndahungira mu maso hawe he?

8.text: Nazamuka nkajya mu ijuru uri yo,Nasasa uburiri bwanjye ikuzimu uri yo.

9.text: Nakwenda amababa y'umuseke,Ngatura ku mpera y'inyanja,

10.text: Aho na ho ukuboko kwawe kwahanshorerera,Ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo kwahamfatira.

11.text: Nakwibwira nti “Ni ukuri umwijima ni wo uri buntwikīre,Umucyo ungose uhinduke ijoro”,

12.text: N'umwijima ntugira icyo uguhisha,Ahubwo ijoro riva nk'amanywa,Umwijima n'umucyo kuri wowe ni kimwe.

13.text: Kuko ari wowe waremye ingingo zanjye,Wanteranirije mu nda ya mama.

14.text: Ndagushimira yuko naremwe uburyo buteye ubwoba butangaza,Imirimo wakoze ni ibitangaza,Ibyo umutima wanjye ubizi neza.

15.text: Igikanka cyanjye ntiwagihishwe,Ubwo naremerwaga mu rwihisho,Ubwo naremesherezwaga ubwenge mu byo hasi y'isi.

16.text: Nkiri urusoro amaso yawe yarandebaga,Mu gitabo cyawe handitswemo iminsi yanjye yose,Yategetswe itarabaho n'umwe.

17.text: Mana, erega ibyo utekereza ni iby'igiciro kuri jye!Erega umubare wabyo ni mwinshi!

18.text: Nabibara biruta umusenyi ubwinshi,Iyo nkangutse turacyari kumwe.

19.text: Mana, icyampa ukica abanyabyaha,Mwa bīcanyi mwe, nimwumve aho ndi.

20.text: Bakuvuga nabi,Abanzi bawe bavugira ubusa izina ryawe.

23.text: Mana, ndondora umenye umutima wanjye,Mvugutira umenye ibyo ntekereza.

24.text: Urebe yuko hariho inzira y'ibibi indimo,Unshorerere mu nzira y'iteka ryose.
